review_candidates.title: Field Deployment Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As Field Deployment Engineer, you are responsible for the end-to-end deployment, installation, commissioning, and sustainment of the company's technical systems at client sites. You own system functionality in the field from initial site survey through on-site acceptance — across both hardware and software. You are also the expert operator on-site: you develop deep mastery of the system, operate it proficiently in the field, and train client teams toward full autonomy. This is an engineer-level role with a strong field and hardware lean — not a pure developer role, not a technician role. The dual hardware and software capability is essential. High travel and extended on-site campaigns are core to this position. Responsibilities Site Assessment: Evaluate customer sites ahead of deployment; identify prerequisites, constraints, and installation requirements. Hardware Deployment: Install, assemble, connect, and bring up the system's physical components and equipment on site. Software Deployment: Install, configure, and parameterise the system's software for each operational context; comfortable on Linux. Commissioning: Bring the full system online and verify correct end-to-end functionality across hardware and software. Integration Support: Support connection of the company's systems with the client's existing operational environment, working alongside integration engineers. Test & Acceptance: Conduct on-site testing and acceptance activities through to client sign-off. Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and networking issues in the field; drive resolution and feed recurring findings back to engineering. System Expertise & Operation: Develop deep, hands-on mastery of the system; operate it proficiently in the field and serve as the on-site technical reference. Training & Enablement: Train and coach client operators and maintainers on system use, operation, and maintenance; build toward their autonomy; contribute to training and maintenance documentation. Maintenance & Sustainment: Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on deployed systems; carry out diagnostics, repairs, and return-to-service procedures. Candidate Requirements 2–5 years of hands-on field or technical experience — field operations, systems integration, test, or manufacturing. Proven proficiency across both hardware and software deployment — comfortable assembling and connecting physical equipment and installing, configuring, and parameterising software. This dual capability is essential, not a nice-to-have. Electromechanical aptitude: hardware assembly, electrical hookup, ability to read technical diagrams and schematics. Networking fundamentals: connectivity setup and diagnostics. Comfortable on Linux; deploying, configuring, and debugging software in operational settings. Systems thinking: ability to reason across an integrated system of multiple subsystems, not a single component. Ability to master the system as an expert user and to teach it — strong communication and coaching skills, comfortable training client personnel. Hands-on maintenance and repair experience: preventive checks, fault diagnosis, corrective action, and return-to-service. Field temperament: autonomous in austere environments, procedurally rigorous, strong safety mindset in safety-critical operational settings. Comfortable with a high travel rate and extended on-site campaigns — this is core to the role. Proficiency in English is mandatory; additional languages relevant to the region of operations are a plus. Nice to Have Experience with complex hardware-software integrated systems. Experience integrating systems with third-party operational environments. Prior experience training or instructing end-users (train-the-trainer). Prior experience in field-based deployments or high-stakes operational environments. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

review_candidates.description: About The Role Grade Level (for internal use): 12 The Revenue Solution Architect (RSA) serves as a technical expert within the Revenue organization, forging close partnerships with Sales, Account Management, Product, Technology and our Enterprise Data Organization. In this position, you will be responsible for translating customer objectives into well-scoped and implementable technical solution designs that align to established product capabilities and supported architectures. The role is execution-oriented; producing high quality technical discovery outputs, solution designs and technical validations that reduce delivery risk and improve deal velocity and progression. Primary Focus Execute solution architecture for opportunities and customer engagement by mapping customer objectives to approved product capabilities, standard integration patterns, and delivery approaches. Produce clear, repeatable architecture artifacts (diagrams, integration flows, assumptions, risks, NFRs) that improve alignment and speed decisions during the sales cycle. Support solution-led customer conversations by shifting discussions from features to workflows/outcomes using existing technical GTM narratives and playbooks. Revenue & Deal Enablement Partner with Sales/Account teams to support customer engagement through technical qualification, requirements clarification, and solution shaping aligned to existing plays. Help improve deal velocity by preparing technical inputs that reduce ambiguity (assumptions, dependencies, sizing inputs, sequencing). Support deal execution by participating in customer technical meetings and responding to technical questions Customer & Commercial Problem Solving Build working knowledge of customer workflows and map them to solution capabilities to support measurable outcomes. Assist in resolving technical objections by providing evidence-based responses grounded in platform capability, reference patterns, and prior implementations (where available). Support retention/expansion motions by identifying adoption blockers and aligning on remediation steps with Account and Revenue teams Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Technology partners to ensure proposed solutions are deployable and supportable within current capabilities and standards. Contribute structured feedback from customer/deal learnings into internal forums (pattern gaps, recurring requirements, common integration issues). Support Revenue teams with clear documentation and execution/follow up on open questions and solution design capability Revenue Acceleration and Enablement Apply standard solution patterns to reduce rework and delivery risk; document reusable modules and lessons learned in knowledge repositories Support prototypes/POCs by following established methodology, validating feasibility, and documenting results and limitations Help standardize technical discovery and architecture documentation within the team by consistent use of approved formats. Contribute to playbooks, documentation and training for revenue-wide capability building Required Experience & Expertise 5+ years in pre-sales solution architecture, technical sales enablement, technology and/or GTM architecture Technical fluency in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) , hyperscalers and modern orchestration approaches. Working fluency in AI/automation concepts, including agentic frameworks and orchestration tools, with the ability to translate capabilities into deployable client solutions. Ability to produce and review core technical artifacts: architecture diagrams, integration flows, NFRs (performance, availability, security) and implementation approach notes. Experience with communicating with mixed audiences (technical and commercial) and deliver concise written outputs that support deal progression. review_candidates.title: Executive Assistant to the CFO
review_candidates.description: Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve. Work Location: This position is designated as remote. However, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays). Position Summary We are seeking a highly skilled, proactive, and operationally minded Executive Assistant to support the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and provide executive support to the SVP, Head of Finance. This role will also serve as a key connector across the Finance organization and broader executive leadership team. This role is designed for a strategic, detail-oriented professional who will be responsible for creating order, driving operational excellence, and ensuring priorities remain aligned, timelines are met, and leaders stay on course. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, has exceptional communication and organizational skills, and is equally comfortable handling high-level executive priorities and day-to-day administrative responsibilities. The successful candidate will have a strong sense of ownership and the ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and proactively bring solutions. This individual must be comfortable operating with a high degree of independence and discretion while supporting two senior Finance leaders and navigating a dynamic, constantly changing environment. Executive Support & Operational Leadership Serve as the primary executive support partner to the CFO, anticipating needs, managing priorities, and ensuring seamless day-to-day operations. Provide executive support to the SVP, Head of Finance, including calendar management, meeting coordination, travel, communications, and other administrative needs. Drive follow-through on decisions, action items, and projects to ensure clarity, accountability, and timely execution. Act as an extension of the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance in meetings and communications, coordinating effectively across Finance and other functions. Help coordinate priorities, deadlines, commitments, and follow-up across the CFO's and SVP's organizations. Proactively identify potential issues, scheduling conflicts, or gaps and bring forward solutions. Coordinate effectively with other Executive Assistants and key stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment and smooth execution. Maintain visibility into important commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items to help keep both executives on track. Presentation Development & Communication Create high-quality presentations, reports, executive team materials, and board-level materials that clearly communicate complex financial and business information. Prepare and format materials using PowerPoint and Excel, ensuring a high degree of accuracy, professionalism, and attention to detail. Support the preparation and coordination of materials for executive leadership meetings, board meetings, Finance meetings, and other key business reviews. Draft executive communications, talking points, meeting agendas, and internal updates as needed. Gather, organize, and synthesize information from multiple stakeholders to support executive priorities and decision-making. Ensure executive communications and materials are clear, polished, timely, and appropriately tailored to the audience. Calendar, Travel & Logistics Management Manage complex, dynamic calendars and prioritize competing scheduling needs for the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance. Exercise sound judgment when determining priorities, resolving scheduling conflicts, and protecting executive time. Coordinate travel itineraries, accommodations, transportation, and detailed briefings to ensure smooth logistics. Plan and execute internal and external meetings, events, and executive engagements. Coordinate meeting logistics, including agendas, materials, participants, conference rooms, technology, and follow-up. Ensure the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance are fully prepared for meetings by anticipating needs and coordinating necessary information and materials in advance. Adjust quickly to changing schedules and priorities while maintaining organization and professionalism. Administrative Excellence Oversee traditional executive administrative activities, including expense reports, document management, contract routing, and other administrative processes. Serve as a point of contact for internal and external partners on behalf of the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance. Coordinate with Finance leaders, executive assistants, and other key stakeholders to facilitate efficient communication and execution. Maintain organized records, files, and workflows, ensuring important information and commitments are easily accessible. Monitor and follow up on outstanding items to ensure timely completion. Continuously refine and improve administrative and operational processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness. Confidentiality & Judgment Handle highly confidential and sensitive financial, business, employee, executive, and organizational information with the highest level of discretion. Exercise exceptional judgment regarding sensitive information, including determining what should be escalated, how information should be communicated, and who should have access to it. Maintain strict confidentiality in all interactions and activities supporting the CFO and Finance organization. Demonstrate sound judgment when working with sensitive business matters and interacting with senior leaders and external partners. Represent the CFO and Finance organization with professionalism, credibility, discretion, and integrity at all times. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent skill-based experience. 7+ years of experience supporting senior executives; experience supporting a C-suite executive strongly preferred. Experience supporting multiple senior executives is preferred. Exceptional organization, project management, and prioritization skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially PowerPoint and Excel. Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly understand and navigate complex business priorities. Strong judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle highly confidential information. This cannot be overstated. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to work both strategically and tactically; comfortable switching between big-picture thinking and detailed execution. Ability to work independently, anticipate needs, and make sound decisions with limited direction. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and support multiple senior leaders in a fast-paced environment. Passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement. Personal Attributes Highly proactive — always one step ahead and consistently anticipating what the CFO and Finance leadership will need. Exceptionally organized — able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, calendars, and stakeholders without losing sight of important details. Business-minded — understands the broader business context and recognizes how effective executive support contributes to organizational success. Collaborative and relationship-oriented — able to build strong relationships and influence without authority. Calm under pressure — maintains composure, professionalism, and sound judgment in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment. Resourceful and solutions-focused — brings solutions and recommendations rather than simply identifying problems. Adaptable and flexible — comfortable navigating shifting priorities, changing schedules, and evolving business needs. Accountable and hands-on — willing to engage wherever needed to drive results. Detail-oriented without losing perspective — able to manage tactical execution while understanding the broader objective. Discreet and trustworthy — understands the importance of maintaining strict confidentiality when supporting senior Finance executives. Strong communicator — communicates clearly, professionally, and appropriately with everyone from employees to senior executives and external partners. Team-oriented — works effectively with the Finance organization, Executive Assistant community, and broader leadership team. Committed to elevating executive effectiveness — takes ownership for creating structure, removing friction, and maximizing the effectiveness of the CFO and Finance leadership team. Physical Demands and Work Environment: Sedentary work (i.e., sitting for long periods of time) exerting up to 35 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force; Occasionally to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects and repetitive motions; Subject to inside environmental conditions; and Travel for this position will include less than 5% locally usually for training purposes. Inovalon Offers a Competitive Salary And Benefits Package In addition to the base compensation, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. The actual base pay offered may vary depending on multiple factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity. At Inovalon, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. Inovalon invests in associates to help them stay healthy, save for long-term financial goals, and manage the demands of work and personal commitments. That’s why Inovalon offers a valuable benefits package with a wide range of choices to meet associate needs, which may include health insurance, life insurance, company-paid disability, 401k, 18+ days of paid time off, and more. Base Compensation Range $36.92—$55.28 USD This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. review_candidates.title: SVN 0151 2026 - ASISTENTE DE PROYECTO (INFRAESTRUCTURA Y WASH), QUIBDO
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introducción Creada en 1951, la OIM – Organización Internacional para las Migraciones es la organización intergubernamental líder en el ámbito de la migración y trabaja en estrecha colaboración con asociados gubernamentales, intergubernamentales y no gubernamentales. La OIM está dedicada a promover la migración humana y ordenada para el beneficio de todos. Esto se hace mediante la prestación de servicios y asesoría a los gobiernos y los migrantes. La OIM se compromete a garantizar un entorno laboral donde todos los empleados puedan prosperar profesionalmente, Lea más sobre la cultura laboral de la OIM en IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Se aceptan solicitudes de candidatos internos y externos. Para todas las vacantes de la OIM, las solicitudes de candidatos cualificados y elegibles de primer nivel se consideran antes que las de candidatos cualificados y elegibles de segundo nivel en el proceso de selección, más información interna and internal-equivalent candidates . Alcance y Contexto Organizacional El 10 de agosto de 2026 se dio un terremoto de magnitud 7,4 en Colombia, tuvo epicentro en San José del Palmar (Chocó), y una profundidad de 103 km. Se trata del evento sísmico de mayor magnitud registrada en Colombia en el siglo XXI según el Servicio Geológico Colombiano. De acuerdo con la Unidad Nacional para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres (UNGRD), 14 departamentos y 357 municipios se han visto afectados. Las cifras oficiales preliminares reportan 377 personas fallecidas, 2,503 personas heridas y 195 personas desaparecidas, así como daños significativos a viviendas, infraestructura pública y servicios esenciales, incluidos 1,136 hogares afectados, 7,300 hogares dañados 48 edificios municipales o gubernamentales afectados y 89 instalaciones de salud afectadas promoviendo la protección y la rendición de cuentas ante las poblaciones afectadas. Se da la necesidad de rehabilitar, reparar y/o equipar la infraestructura comunitaria afectada por la crisis. Se realizarán evaluaciones preliminares y evaluaciones estructurales en colaboración con las autoridades pertinentes para garantizar que la infraestructura priorizada no presente riesgo de colapso y sea segura. Con el propósito de fortalecer las actividades del programa, se requiere la contratación de 4 asistentes de proyecto para Infraestructura – WASH que apoyen la implementación y seguimiento de las actividades del proyecto, incluyendo acciones de instalación, mejoramiento y rehabilitación de infraestructuras en alojamientos, escuelas, hospitales, centros o espacios comunitarios, domicilios, entre otras. Igualmente, que sirvan de apoyo a los procesos de asistencia humanitaria, cuando esto se requiera. Responsibilities Ayudar en la implementación y seguimiento de las actividades de infraestructura y WASH del programa. Realizar la inspección visual del estado de las infraestructuras en los sitios que se le asignen y reportar los hallazgos al supervisor. Recopilar y presentar información/datos sobre temas específicos de infraestructura y WASH de acuerdo con evaluaciones de necesidades sobre el terreno y fuentes secundarias. Dar seguimiento al presupuesto; verificar la disponibilidad de fondos; obtener las aprobaciones necesarias y actualizar la información relacionada con el presupuesto de las actividades de WASH e Infraestructura. Apoyar la coordinación de la implementación de las acciones de infraestructura y WASH, en conjunto con las unidades de apoyo del programa y de acuerdo con los estándares de WASH e Infraestructura. Redactar informes de estado, presentaciones, monitoreo y seguimiento, identificando deficiencias en la entrega, llevarlas a la atención del supervisor y sugerir acciones correctivas. Acompañar, junto con los proveedores, el gobierno y las comunidades las acciones de mejora, dotación o adecuación en infraestructura y WASH donde se requiera Participar en reuniones, conferencias, talleres y formaciones y ayudar a coordinar las actividades de implementación con autoridades locales, socios, agencias de las Naciones Unidas, organizaciones intergubernamentales y no gubernamentales, donantes y otras partes interesadas en las acciones de WASH e Infraestructura. Realizar otras tareas relacionadas según se asignen. Qualifications Experiencia y Cualidades Requeridas Educación Profesional en arquitectur, Ingenieria Civil, Construccion o carreras en áreas afines con mínimo dos (2) años de experiencia relevante; o Bachiller con mínimo cuatro (4) años de experiencia pertinente Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experiencia Experiencia en intervenciones en agua, saneamiento e higiene y diseño, adecuación y mejora de infraestructuras en alojamientos temporales, espacios comunitarios y públicos. Experiencia en el trato con autoridades gubernamentales, instituciones nacionales/internacionales, agencias de las Naciones Unidas y organizaciones no gubernamentales; Experiencia en trabajar con migrantes, refugiados, personas desplazadas internamente, víctimas de tráfico y otros grupos vulnerables; y, Experiencia laboral previa con organizaciones humanitarias internacionales, instituciones u organizaciones gubernamentales/no gubernamentales en un entorno multicultural es una ventaja Aptitudes Conocimientos en normativas y reglamentaciones de construcción y urbanismo, nacionales y locales. Conocimiento en trabajo participativo y enfoques comunitarios de participación Conocimientos en accesibilidad universal y diseño inclusivo de espacios públicos Conocimientos de enfoques medio ambientales y alternativas sostenibles en obras e intervenciones WASH Lenguaje Todos los miembros del personal de la OIM, en todas las categorías, deben tener dominio de al menos uno de los idiomas oficiales de la OIM (inglés, francés o español). Para Esta Posición Requerido: Todos los candidatos deberán desenvolverse con fluidez en español (oral y escrito). Deseable Contar con un nivel de inglés Avanzado (oral y escrito) El dominio del/de los idioma(s) requerido(s) será evaluado específicamente durante el proceso de selección, el cual podrá incluir evaluaciones escritas y/o orales. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Notes Consulte este link para obtener orientación sobre la categoría de empleo de la OIM Toda oferta que se le haga al candidato en relación con esta vacante está sujeta a la confirmación de la financiación. Este proceso de selección podrá utilizarse para cubrir puestos similares en diversos lugares de destino. El nombramiento estará sujeto a la certificación de aptitud médica del candidato, la acreditación, los requisitos de residencia o visado y las autorizaciones de seguridad. La OIM mantiene una política de tolerancia cero ante conductas incompatibles con los fines y objetivos de las Naciones Unidas y la OIM, incluyendo la explotación y el abuso sexuales, el acoso sexual, el abuso de autoridad y la discriminación por motivos de género, nacionalidad, edad, raza, orientación sexual, origen religioso o étnico, o discapacidad. La OIM no cobra ninguna tarifa en ninguna etapa de su proceso de contratación (solicitud, entrevista, tramitación, formación u otros cargos). La OIM no solicita información sobre cuentas bancaria. La OIM solo acepta solicitudes debidamente completadas y enviadas a través del IOM e-Recruitment (for internal candidates link here). Esta herramienta en línea también permite a los candidatos realizar un seguimiento del estado de su solicitud. No se aceptarán solicitudes tardías. Solo se contactará a los candidatos preseleccionados. Para obtener más información y otras ofertas de empleo, le invitamos a visitar nuestro sitio web: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies Importante: Damos claridad que esta oferta está sujeta a disponibilidad de fondos, una vez suscrito el proyecto la implementación deberá iniciar de manera inmediata.

Se da la necesidad de rehabilitar, reparar y/o equipar la infraestructura comunitaria afectada por la crisis. Se realizarán evaluaciones preliminares y evaluaciones estructurales en colaboración con las autoridades pertinentes para garantizar que la infraestructura priorizada no presente riesgo de colapso y sea segura. Con el propósito de fortalecer las actividades del programa, se requiere la contratación de 4 asistentes de proyecto para Infraestructura – WASH que apoyen la implementación y seguimiento de las actividades del proyecto, incluyendo acciones de instalación, mejoramiento y rehabilitación de infraestructuras en alojamientos, escuelas, hospitales, centros o espacios comunitarios, domicilios, entre otras. Igualmente, que sirvan de apoyo a los procesos de asistencia humanitaria, cuando esto se requiera. Responsibilities Ayudar en la implementación y seguimiento de las actividades de infraestructura y WASH del programa. Realizar la inspección visual del estado de las infraestructuras en los sitios que se le asignen y reportar los hallazgos al supervisor. Recopilar y presentar información/datos sobre temas específicos de infraestructura y WASH de acuerdo con evaluaciones de necesidades sobre el terreno y fuentes secundarias. Dar seguimiento al presupuesto; verificar la disponibilidad de fondos; obtener las aprobaciones necesarias y actualizar la información relacionada con el presupuesto de las actividades de WASH e Infraestructura. Apoyar la coordinación de la implementación de las acciones de infraestructura y WASH, en conjunto con las unidades de apoyo del programa y de acuerdo con los estándares de WASH e Infraestructura. Redactar informes de estado, presentaciones, monitoreo y seguimiento, identificando deficiencias en la entrega, llevarlas a la atención del supervisor y sugerir acciones correctivas. Acompañar, junto con los proveedores, el gobierno y las comunidades las acciones de mejora, dotación o adecuación en infraestructura y WASH donde se requiera Participar en reuniones, conferencias, talleres y formaciones y ayudar a coordinar las actividades de implementación con autoridades locales, socios, agencias de las Naciones Unidas, organizaciones intergubernamentales y no gubernamentales, donantes y otras partes interesadas en las acciones de WASH e Infraestructura. Rejoindre MIGEN, c’est intégrer une entreprise à taille humaine, proche du terrain, où la sécurité, l’expertise technique et la qualité des interventions sont au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Vous habitez à Ernée ou à proximité ? Ce poste est basé à Ernée et les interventions se concentrent sur le secteur. Vos missions Sous la conduite d'un Chargé de travaux , vous intervenez chez nos clients industriels et tertiaires pour réaliser des opérations électriques en basse tension, hors tension comme sous tension. Vous intervenez notamment sur : Réaliser les opérations d'ordre électrique BT qui vous sont confiées, en appliquant strictement les modes opératoires et les consignes de sécurité. Réaliser les interventions sous tension dans le respect des conditions d'exécution du travail définies pour chaque opération. Vérifier avant chaque intervention l'état de votre outillage isolé, de vos EPI et de votre matériel de contrôle. Poser des chemins de câbles, tirer et raccorder les câbles. Installer l'appareillage, les coffrets, l'éclairage et les circuits de distribution. Câbler et raccorder les armoires, coffrets et TGBT. Remplacer les composants électriques défectueux et réaliser l'ajout de départs. Effectuer les contrôles, mesures et essais élémentaires avant remise en service. Signaler immédiatement au Chargé de travaux tout écart, anomalie ou situation dangereuse. Renseigner les documents d'intervention et rendre compte de l'avancement des travaux. Maintenir la zone de travail propre, balisée et sécurisée jusqu'à la fin du chantier. Vous intervenez en binôme ou au sein d'une équipe de 2 à 5 personnes , sur des chantiers de travaux neufs, de rénovation et de maintenance électrique. Votre profil Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation CAP Électricien, Bac Pro MELEC ou équivalent . Vous justifiez d'au moins 2 ans d'expérience en électricité industrielle ou tertiaire , avec une première pratique des travaux sous tension BT . Vous disposez de l'habilitation B1T . Vous maîtrisez : La lecture de schémas électriques et de plans d'implantation. L'utilisation des appareils de mesure courants. Les opérations électriques en basse tension. Les règles de sécurité liées aux travaux sous tension. Le travail en équipe et les interventions sur chantier. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre minutie et votre vigilance , notamment dans le respect des règles de sécurité. Votre ponctualité, votre esprit d'équipe et votre bonne présentation chez le client seront également essentiels. Prérequis Habilitation B1T en cours de validité selon la norme NF C 18-510. Formation TST BT à jour, avec un recyclage de moins de 3 ans. Permis B indispensable pour les déplacements quotidiens sur le secteur de Rennes. Aptitude médicale compatible avec les travaux sous tension et le travail en hauteur. Les habilitations B1V, BR, H0V , ainsi que le CACES R486 catégorie B , l'AIPR, le SST et les autorisations de travail en hauteur sont appréciés. Si certaines habilitations complémentaires sont nécessaires, elles pourront être complétées ou financées à l'embauche. Rémunération et avantages 27 000 à 32 000 € brut annuels, sur 12 mois, selon votre expérience et les habilitations détenues. Paniers repas. Indemnités de déplacement selon la grille en vigueur. Possibilité d'évolution vers un poste de Chargé de travaux B2T, avec accompagnement et formation interne. Poste basé à Rennes (35), avec déplacements quotidiens dans un rayon d'environ 60 km.

review_candidates.description: The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems. CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally. At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work http//www.clintonhealthaccess.org CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture. Program Overview CHAI has been legally registered as an international NGO in China since the establishment of its China representative office in 2022. As a part of CHAI's China Country Team, the Market Access projects in the office strive to build healthier global marketplaces to ensure the sustainable supply of vital medical commodities, and apply CHAI's global market-shaping approaches in China. In particular, the program works to identify and evaluate health product suppliers that can competitively and reliably supply low- and middle-income country markets, including those that provide pharmaceuticals, diagnostic tools, devices, vaccines, vector control tools, and assistive technologies. When suitable, the team also engages in designing, negotiating, and supporting the effective implementation of market-shaping interventions that can increase access to critical health commodities. Example market-shaping interventions range from traditional policy-led and grant-financed initiatives such as pooled procurement, coordinated ordering, and strategic demand forecasting to more innovative incentive mechanisms such as volume guarantees (VGs) and advance market commitments. As with CHAI's work in other countries, the team collaborates closely with internal and external stakeholders to evaluate the public health impact of potential interventions involving China-based suppliers and ensure alignment with current and future policy goals. The team also focuses on sharing market intelligence and demand information among Chinese suppliers, international organizations, and public entities. The objective is to enable evidence-based decision-making that can help to close global supply gaps and improve the availability and affordability of essential health products worldwide. A bias toward documenting what you learn so the rest of the team and our merchants benefit. Right to work in the UK. Salary Range OTE £75,000 to £85,000, commensurate with experience. Benefits Competitive salary. Employer-contributed private medical through our UK EOR. Workplace pension. Flexible time off plus UK bank holidays. Remote-friendly. Home office stipend. Quarterly merchant stipend. Lots of swag drops.

You own system functionality in the field from initial site survey through on-site acceptance — across both hardware and software. You are also the expert operator on-site: you develop deep mastery of the system, operate it proficiently in the field, and train client teams toward full autonomy. This is an engineer-level role with a strong field and hardware lean — not a pure developer role, not a technician role. The dual hardware and software capability is essential. High travel and extended on-site campaigns are core to this position. Responsibilities Site Assessment: Evaluate customer sites ahead of deployment; identify prerequisites, constraints, and installation requirements. Hardware Deployment: Install, assemble, connect, and bring up the system's physical components and equipment on site. Software Deployment: Install, configure, and parameterise the system's software for each operational context; comfortable on Linux. Commissioning: Bring the full system online and verify correct end-to-end functionality across hardware and software. Integration Support: Support connection of the company's systems with the client's existing operational environment, working alongside integration engineers. Test & Acceptance: Conduct on-site testing and acceptance activities through to client sign-off. Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and networking issues in the field; drive resolution and feed recurring findings back to engineering. System Expertise & Operation: Develop deep, hands-on mastery of the system; operate it proficiently in the field and serve as the on-site technical reference. Training & Enablement: Train and coach client operators and maintainers on system use, operation, and maintenance; build toward their autonomy; contribute to training and maintenance documentation. Maintenance & Sustainment: Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on deployed systems; carry out diagnostics, repairs, and return-to-service procedures. Candidate Requirements 2–5 years of hands-on field or technical experience — field operations, systems integration, test, or manufacturing. Proven proficiency across both hardware and software deployment — comfortable assembling and connecting physical equipment and installing, configuring, and parameterising software. This dual capability is essential, not a nice-to-have. Electromechanical aptitude: hardware assembly, electrical hookup, ability to read technical diagrams and schematics. Networking fundamentals: connectivity setup and diagnostics. Comfortable on Linux; deploying, configuring, and debugging software in operational settings. Systems thinking: ability to reason across an integrated system of multiple subsystems, not a single component. Ability to master the system as an expert user and to teach it — strong communication and coaching skills, comfortable training client personnel. Hands-on maintenance and repair experience: preventive checks, fault diagnosis, corrective action, and return-to-service. Field temperament: autonomous in austere environments, procedurally rigorous, strong safety mindset in safety-critical operational settings. Comfortable with a high travel rate and extended on-site campaigns — this is core to the role. Proficiency in English is mandatory; additional languages relevant to the region of operations are a plus. Nice to Have Experience with complex hardware-software integrated systems. Experience integrating systems with third-party operational environments. Prior experience training or instructing end-users (train-the-trainer). This role will also serve as a key connector across the Finance organization and broader executive leadership team. Act as an extension of the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance in meetings and communications, coordinating effectively across Finance and other functions. Help coordinate priorities, deadlines, commitments, and follow-up across the CFO's and SVP's organizations. Proactively identify potential issues, scheduling conflicts, or gaps and bring forward solutions. Coordinate effectively with other Executive Assistants and key stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment and smooth execution. Maintain visibility into important commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items to help keep both executives on track. Gather, organize, and synthesize information from multiple stakeholders to support executive priorities and decision-making. Ensure executive communications and materials are clear, polished, timely, and appropriately tailored to the audience. Calendar, Travel & Logistics Management Manage complex, dynamic calendars and prioritize competing scheduling needs for the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance. Exercise sound judgment when determining priorities, resolving scheduling conflicts, and protecting executive time. Coordinate travel itineraries, accommodations, transportation, and detailed briefings to ensure smooth logistics. Plan and execute internal and external meetings, events, and executive engagements. Coordinate meeting logistics, including agendas, materials, participants, conference rooms, technology, and follow-up. Ensure the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance are fully prepared for meetings by anticipating needs and coordinating necessary information and materials in advance. Adjust quickly to changing schedules and priorities while maintaining organization and professionalism. Administrative Excellence Oversee traditional executive administrative activities, including expense reports, document management, contract routing, and other administrative processes. Serve as a point of contact for internal and external partners on behalf of the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance. Coordinate with Finance leaders, executive assistants, and other key stakeholders to facilitate efficient communication and execution. Maintain organized records, files, and workflows, ensuring important information and commitments are easily accessible. Monitor and follow up on outstanding items to ensure timely completion. Continuously refine and improve administrative and operational processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness. Confidentiality & Judgment Handle highly confidential and sensitive financial, business, employee, executive, and organizational information with the highest level of discretion. Exercise exceptional judgment regarding sensitive information, including determining what should be escalated, how information should be communicated, and who should have access to it. Maintain strict confidentiality in all interactions and activities supporting the CFO and Finance organization. Demonstrate sound judgment when working with sensitive business matters and interacting with senior leaders and external partners. Represent the CFO and Finance organization with professionalism, credibility, discretion, and integrity at all times. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent skill-based experience. 7+ years of experience supporting senior executives; experience supporting a C-suite executive strongly preferred. Experience supporting multiple senior executives is preferred. Exceptional organization, project management, and prioritization skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially PowerPoint and Excel. Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly understand and navigate complex business priorities. Strong judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle highly confidential information. This cannot be overstated. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to work both strategically and tactically; comfortable switching between big-picture thinking and detailed execution. Ability to work independently, anticipate needs, and make sound decisions with limited direction. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and support multiple senior leaders in a fast-paced environment. Passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement. Personal Attributes Highly proactive — always one step ahead and consistently anticipating what the CFO and Finance leadership will need. Exceptionally organized — able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, calendars, and stakeholders without losing sight of important details. Business-minded — understands the broader business context and recognizes how effective executive support contributes to organizational success. Collaborative and relationship-oriented — able to build strong relationships and influence without authority. Calm under pressure — maintains composure, professionalism, and sound judgment in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment. Resourceful and solutions-focused — brings solutions and recommendations rather than simply identifying problems. Adaptable and flexible — comfortable navigating shifting priorities, changing schedules, and evolving business needs. Accountable and hands-on — willing to engage wherever needed to drive results. Detail-oriented without losing perspective — able to manage tactical execution while understanding the broader objective. Discreet and trustworthy — understands the importance of maintaining strict confidentiality when supporting senior Finance executives. Strong communicator — communicates clearly, professionally, and appropriately with everyone from employees to senior executives and external partners. Team-oriented — works effectively with the Finance organization, Executive Assistant community, and broader leadership team. Committed to elevating executive effectiveness — takes ownership for creating structure, removing friction, and maximizing the effectiveness of the CFO and Finance leadership team. This role has the responsibility to promote Fluor’s competitiveness within the global marketplace by delivering quality services of unmatched value and technical competence. Review vendor equipment documentation within the discipline and from other disciplines for compliance with project requirements, and actively seek discrepancy resolution Analyze and make independent recommendations regarding solutions to problems with varying complexity in accordance with organization and/or project objectives and guidelines Indicate strong technical interests and background with structural engineering subjects such as design of large structural steel and concrete structures including heavy foundations, seismic engineering, and dynamic analysis of structures supporting vibrating equipment. a recognized professional certification or registration in the applicable field, if required; some locations may have additional or different qualifications in order to comply with local requirements Minimun of 4 years experience in Mining projects Ability to communicate effectively with audiences that include but are not limited to management, coworkers, clients, vendors, contractors, and visitors Job related technical knowledge necessary to complete the job Ability to learn and apply knowledge of applicable local, state/province, and federal/national statutes and guidelines Ability to attend to detail and work in a time-conscious and time-effective manner Professional registration and membership in technical society (preferred) Advanced knowledge of discipline codes and standards, commercial availability and cost of materials Effort-hour estimating and staff forecasting Managing and leading a large project Project set-up, developing control-level schedules, progress reporting and project close-out Practical field experience Intermediate computer and software skills to include the use of word processing, e-mail, spreadsheet and electronic presentation programs Other Job Requirements Preferred Qualifications Fluor Canada rewards hard work, knowledge, and commitment. new_matches.title: SVN 0151 2026 - ASISTENTE DE PROYECTO (INFRAESTRUCTURA Y WASH), QUIBDO
new_matches.description: Job Description Introducción Creada en 1951, la OIM – Organización Internacional para las Migraciones es la organización intergubernamental líder en el ámbito de la migración y trabaja en estrecha colaboración con asociados gubernamentales, intergubernamentales y no gubernamentales. La OIM está dedicada a promover la migración humana y ordenada para el beneficio de todos. Esto se hace mediante la prestación de servicios y asesoría a los gobiernos y los migrantes. La OIM se compromete a garantizar un entorno laboral donde todos los empleados puedan prosperar profesionalmente, Lea más sobre la cultura laboral de la OIM en IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Se aceptan solicitudes de candidatos internos y externos. Para todas las vacantes de la OIM, las solicitudes de candidatos cualificados y elegibles de primer nivel se consideran antes que las de candidatos cualificados y elegibles de segundo nivel en el proceso de selección, más información interna and internal-equivalent candidates . Alcance y Contexto Organizacional El 10 de agosto de 2026 se dio un terremoto de magnitud 7,4 en Colombia, tuvo epicentro en San José del Palmar (Chocó), y una profundidad de 103 km. Se trata del evento sísmico de mayor magnitud registrada en Colombia en el siglo XXI según el Servicio Geológico Colombiano. De acuerdo con la Unidad Nacional para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres (UNGRD), 14 departamentos y 357 municipios se han visto afectados. Las cifras oficiales preliminares reportan 377 personas fallecidas, 2,503 personas heridas y 195 personas desaparecidas, así como daños significativos a viviendas, infraestructura pública y servicios esenciales, incluidos 1,136 hogares afectados, 7,300 hogares dañados 48 edificios municipales o gubernamentales afectados y 89 instalaciones de salud afectadas promoviendo la protección y la rendición de cuentas ante las poblaciones afectadas. Se da la necesidad de rehabilitar, reparar y/o equipar la infraestructura comunitaria afectada por la crisis. Se realizarán evaluaciones preliminares y evaluaciones estructurales en colaboración con las autoridades pertinentes para garantizar que la infraestructura priorizada no presente riesgo de colapso y sea segura. Con el propósito de fortalecer las actividades del programa, se requiere la contratación de 4 asistentes de proyecto para Infraestructura – WASH que apoyen la implementación y seguimiento de las actividades del proyecto, incluyendo acciones de instalación, mejoramiento y rehabilitación de infraestructuras en alojamientos, escuelas, hospitales, centros o espacios comunitarios, domicilios, entre otras. Igualmente, que sirvan de apoyo a los procesos de asistencia humanitaria, cuando esto se requiera. Responsibilities Ayudar en la implementación y seguimiento de las actividades de infraestructura y WASH del programa. Realizar la inspección visual del estado de las infraestructuras en los sitios que se le asignen y reportar los hallazgos al supervisor. Recopilar y presentar información/datos sobre temas específicos de infraestructura y WASH de acuerdo con evaluaciones de necesidades sobre el terreno y fuentes secundarias. Dar seguimiento al presupuesto; verificar la disponibilidad de fondos; obtener las aprobaciones necesarias y actualizar la información relacionada con el presupuesto de las actividades de WASH e Infraestructura. Apoyar la coordinación de la implementación de las acciones de infraestructura y WASH, en conjunto con las unidades de apoyo del programa y de acuerdo con los estándares de WASH e Infraestructura. Redactar informes de estado, presentaciones, monitoreo y seguimiento, identificando deficiencias en la entrega, llevarlas a la atención del supervisor y sugerir acciones correctivas. Acompañar, junto con los proveedores, el gobierno y las comunidades las acciones de mejora, dotación o adecuación en infraestructura y WASH donde se requiera Participar en reuniones, conferencias, talleres y formaciones y ayudar a coordinar las actividades de implementación con autoridades locales, socios, agencias de las Naciones Unidas, organizaciones intergubernamentales y no gubernamentales, donantes y otras partes interesadas en las acciones de WASH e Infraestructura. Realizar otras tareas relacionadas según se asignen. Qualifications Experiencia y Cualidades Requeridas Educación Profesional en arquitectur, Ingenieria Civil, Construccion o carreras en áreas afines con mínimo dos (2) años de experiencia relevante; o Bachiller con mínimo cuatro (4) años de experiencia pertinente Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experiencia Experiencia en intervenciones en agua, saneamiento e higiene y diseño, adecuación y mejora de infraestructuras en alojamientos temporales, espacios comunitarios y públicos. Experiencia en el trato con autoridades gubernamentales, instituciones nacionales/internacionales, agencias de las Naciones Unidas y organizaciones no gubernamentales; Experiencia en trabajar con migrantes, refugiados, personas desplazadas internamente, víctimas de tráfico y otros grupos vulnerables; y, Experiencia laboral previa con organizaciones humanitarias internacionales, instituciones u organizaciones gubernamentales/no gubernamentales en un entorno multicultural es una ventaja Aptitudes Conocimientos en normativas y reglamentaciones de construcción y urbanismo, nacionales y locales. Conocimiento en trabajo participativo y enfoques comunitarios de participación Conocimientos en accesibilidad universal y diseño inclusivo de espacios públicos Conocimientos de enfoques medio ambientales y alternativas sostenibles en obras e intervenciones WASH Lenguaje Todos los miembros del personal de la OIM, en todas las categorías, deben tener dominio de al menos uno de los idiomas oficiales de la OIM (inglés, francés o español). Para Esta Posición Requerido: Todos los candidatos deberán desenvolverse con fluidez en español (oral y escrito). Deseable Contar con un nivel de inglés Avanzado (oral y escrito) El dominio del/de los idioma(s) requerido(s) será evaluado específicamente durante el proceso de selección, el cual podrá incluir evaluaciones escritas y/o orales. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Notes Consulte este link para obtener orientación sobre la categoría de empleo de la OIM Toda oferta que se le haga al candidato en relación con esta vacante está sujeta a la confirmación de la financiación. Este proceso de selección podrá utilizarse para cubrir puestos similares en diversos lugares de destino. Los candidatos recomendados mantendrán su elegibilidad para un puesto similar durante un período de 24 meses. El nombramiento estará sujeto a la certificación de aptitud médica del candidato, la acreditación, los requisitos de residencia o visado y las autorizaciones de seguridad. La OIM mantiene una política de tolerancia cero ante conductas incompatibles con los fines y objetivos de las Naciones Unidas y la OIM, incluyendo la explotación y el abuso sexuales, el acoso sexual, el abuso de autoridad y la discriminación por motivos de género, nacionalidad, edad, raza, orientación sexual, origen religioso o étnico, o discapacidad. La OIM no cobra ninguna tarifa en ninguna etapa de su proceso de contratación (solicitud, entrevista, tramitación, formación u otros cargos). La OIM no solicita información sobre cuentas bancaria. La OIM solo acepta solicitudes debidamente completadas y enviadas a través del IOM e-Recruitment (for internal candidates link here). Esta herramienta en línea también permite a los candidatos realizar un seguimiento del estado de su solicitud. No se aceptarán solicitudes tardías. Solo se contactará a los candidatos preseleccionados. Para obtener más información y otras ofertas de empleo, le invitamos a visitar nuestro sitio web: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies Importante: Damos claridad que esta oferta está sujeta a disponibilidad de fondos, una vez suscrito el proyecto la implementación deberá iniciar de manera inmediata.

We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally. At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. Effective communication and customer service skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear, user-friendly language. Ability to prioritize tasks, manage time efficiently, and work both independently and within a team. Relevant education in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience with ticketing systems, remote support tools, and common office applications is an advantage. Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving systems and processes.

Working with the Information Technology team, compose and disseminate corporate-wide IT communications and end-user documentation. Maintain and update corporate-wide IT end-user documentation. Effectively assist as a technical resource with all general support and infrastructure problems and projects. Interact with team members in the development of new service programs and in the efficient provision of services currently offered. Perform helpdesk duties including Call Center responsibilities & trouble ticket completion. Qualifications and skills: ⁃ 1-5 years of experience in an IT support environment. ⁃ Degree from an accredited college or university in a related field, or equivalent years of specialized technical experience and/or technical training. Experience providing technical customer support on the phone, online, and in person. ⁃ Must have experience in supporting Windows operating systems. Audio/visual maintenance and support is desired. Familiarity with MACs and Google Apps is a plus. ⁃ Possess knowledge and expertise in Microsoft Products - including Server and desktop. ⁃ Possess demonstrated knowledge and expertise in resolving issues relating to network connectivity, hardware, software, and end-user problems for all facilities’ Local Area Networks (LANs), printers, and periphera Must be able to work independently and as part of a team providing timely, high-quality services.
